extraction.name: MMStar
extraction.description: MMStar is an elite vision-indispensable multi-modal benchmark comprising 1,500 samples meticulously selected by humans. It benchmarks 6 core capabilities and 18 detailed axes to evaluate large vision-language models' multi-modal capacities with carefully balanced and purified samples.
extraction.creator: Lin Chen; Jinsong Li; Xiaoyi Dong; Pan Zhang; Yuhang Zang; Zehui Chen; Haodong Duan; Jiaqi Wang; Yu Qiao; Dahua Lin; Feng Zhao
extraction.citeAs: Lin Chen, Jinsong Li, Xiaoyi Dong, Pan Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Zehui Chen, Haodong Duan, Jiaqi Wang, Yu Qiao, Dahua Lin, Feng Zhao. Are We on the Right Way for Evaluating Large Vision-Language Models? arXiv:2403.20330v2, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Samples were collected by aggregating six existing multi-modal benchmarks, applying an automated filtering pipeline using LLMs to exclude samples lacking visual dependency or exhibiting data leakage, and finally conducting a manual review by three experts to curate 1,500 high-quality samples.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis; Software Collection; Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Six existing multi-modal benchmarks: MMBench, SEED, MMMU, ScienceQA, AI2D, and MathVista.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Three experts conducted a manual review process to ensure each sample's answer is based on the understanding of visual content, covers a comprehensive range of capability assessment dimensions, and requires advanced multi-modal abilities for resolution.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT4-Turbo; GeminiPro; LLaMA-70B; Qwen-1.5-72B; Mixtral-8x7B; GPT4V; GeminiPro-Vision; LLaVA
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: evaluate LVLMs' multi-modal capacities; comparing existing LVLMs
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Samples were preliminarily filtered using an automated pipeline with LLM inspectors, retaining only samples with two or fewer hits (correct answers without visual input). This was followed by a manual review process by experts to curate 1,500 high-quality samples. All questions were also converted into a multiple-choice format.
